historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved, 7-0, a six-unit residential condominium conversion of the building.
The City Planning Commission approved, 6-0, converting the six-unit building to condominiums (Motion 13981).
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved merging two of the building's six units, leaving five, 5-1.
An existing six-unit building stood on the site.
